name: TX-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strongly Republican district (R+13 PVI) with no Democratic polling presence
Steinmann has outraised the Democrat roughly 75-to-1 and has outside support
Open seat removes incumbent advantage but does not change the partisan lean
model.rationale: The R+13 district, a near-total fundraising gap, and prediction markets at roughly 95% Republican all point the same way, with no polls or ratings suggesting competition. The forecast stays at a large Republican margin consistent with the seat's partisan lean.
model.watch: Any late Democratic polling or outside spending in the district would be the first sign the race is closer than the fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Morgan Luttrell (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
This open suburban Houston-area seat is strongly Republican, with a partisan lean of about 13 points toward the GOP. Morgan Luttrell's retirement puts a new Republican name on the ballot, but the district's fundamentals remain heavily favorable to the party holding the seat.

Republican Jessica Hart Steinmann has raised about $2.4 million and drawn outside support, while Democrat Laura Jones has raised roughly $31,000 with no outside help. No public polls cover the race, and prediction markets price the Republican at about 95%. The forecast expects a comfortable Republican win, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
